witness.evidence: The displayed proof controls the alternating J contribution under a constant real structure. A general constant separator S+tJ also has a symmetric contribution S and an ordinary denominator that can depend on t; a zero alternating target numerator does not alone exclude improvement of that ratio. Frequency-dependent and globally coupled constructions are additional unaddressed cases. However, the original text expressly lists these exclusions, so one must decide whether its headline is actually intended universally before counting a positive error.
